title: Alasdair McLellan
info: Alasdair McLellan은 영국의 포토그래퍼다. 그의 작업은 런던 현대미술연구소(ICA)에서 전시되었고 런던 국립초상화미술관 소장품에도 포함되어 있다. Alasdair McLellan is a British photographer. His work has been shown at the Institute of Contemporary Arts in London and is held in the collection of the National Portrait Gallery, also in London.
